integrity: Analytic proof includes exact finite identity, factorial moments and uniform tree-component tail estimates; reproducible exhaustive finite checks supplement but do not establish asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted binary simple-graph additive endpoint valuations only; nontrivial-tree EF existence criterion is known from 2024; new claims concern optimal envy deficit and Erdős–Rényi critical-window Poisson distribution. The distribution is for optimal allocations in a random valuation graph, not uniformly random allocations. Related 2026 full text inaccessible; independently verified novelty and scientific validation not claimed.
title: A Poisson window for unavoidable envy in random graphical allocations
